findings.actualSourceBehavior: validatePlanEdits admits40-hex syntax. The outer missing-base check skips only shallow clones. provenanceFailures returns on a matching compiled pin at50 before checking baseCommit ancestry at51, so the dist row passes provenance despite a false origin record.
findings.contract: PR38 merge note says the snapshot baseCommit must remain an ancestor of HEAD; README says baseCommit must stay an ancestor and records the commit the pinned build was taken at. D-15 records provenance by base commit. Source rows enforce this but compiled rows do not.

evidence.excerpt:
## Build outputs under `dist/`

Some parity tests also hash build outputs, listed as `compiledContracts` in a `restoration.json`. Git does not track `dist/`, so the script archives a pinned output from disk, and only when its bytes still equal the pin. Registering `src/X.ts` also registers its pinned `dist/X.d.ts` and `dist/X.js`; pass any other pinned output, such as `dist/index.d.ts` for an edit that changes what it re-exports, explicitly. If you already rebuilt, the script refuses; rebuild at the base commit and run it again.

## Rebasing onto a rewritten base

`baseCommit` must stay an ancestor of `HEAD`. If a squash merge rewrites your base, remove your entries from `manifest.json`, delete their archives and run the script again with the new base. Otherwise the provenance test fails.

## Manifest fields

`manifest.json` holds `schemaVersion` (1), `decision` ("D-15") and `files`, sorted by `path` with each path at most once. Each entry has:

- `path`: the repository-relative POSIX path of the edited file.
- `issue`: the plan issue that archived it, for example `P0-06`.
- `baseCommit`: the 40-hex commit whose bytes were archived; for a `dist/` output, the commit the pinned build was taken at.
- `archivePath`: `unused-code/plan-edits/<issue>/<path>.landed`.
- `sha256`: the sha256 of the archived bytes. The helper refuses an archive that no longer matches.

findings.currentManifestAffected: Current main has two compiled rows. Both current bases are actual ancestors and both archives match every compiled pin; no existing bad archive is observed.
findings.recommendedQualification: Run a dist-only unrelated/missing-base mutation, require failure without changing pins or snapshots, and extend ancestry enforcement to every row before the compiled/source-specific byte checks. Keep the documented shallow-only missing-commit behavior.
findings.executionStatus: Source-derived; this reviewer did not run tests or mutants. Root owns current baseline and mutations.

test: let D-15 snapshot package.json before an issue edits its entries

The snapshot script and validatePlanEdits refused package.json because the
P0-01 package-entries pin froze it by its entries alone. P0-09 must add the
./trust export and a files entry, so package.json is now archived like any
other frozen file. The four tests that pin the entries already read
landedBytes("package.json"), so they keep checking the landed manifest.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test: expect package.json to be snapshotted like any frozen file (D-15)

P0-09 changes package.json exports and files, which the P0-01 package-entries
pin freezes. Snapshot-on-edit already covers every other frozen file; these
tests now expect it to cover package.json too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

packageHandling.scope: Original PR38 refused package.json, but later P0-09 needs ./trust exports/files edits. The two accepted-main commits document and test package snapshot handling. The same four package-entries freezes already route via landedBytes; entry fields remain name/type/main/types/exports/bin/files. Do not restore the obsolete PR38 package refusal.

metaFreeze.scope: P0-47 legitimately snapshots its pre-edit frozen test at P0-01 head51f425bf. Current archive equals exact base bytes and that base is an ancestor. workspacePathRedactionParity reads this snapshot for the text freeze; the actual test itself still executes current code.

limits: All19 original routing changes were reviewed. Counts are supporting inventory, not a substitute for body inspection.

Current later diffs in5 routed files concern P0-09 trust pinning, P0-23 claim labels and P0-27 v2 PDF input. They remain behavioral qualification dependencies; this P0-47 review does not qualify those issues.
In a shallow clone missing a base, the provenance test may skip by explicit contract. This checkout is complete, not shallow.
Compiled archives prove equality to restoration pins; without external build receipts, those bytes alone do not prove the compiler/environment or build was actually produced at baseCommit.
No tests, builds, historical probes or mutants were run by this reviewer.
No source, candidate, refs, trackers, original archives, helper or frozen assertion was edited by this reviewer.
